user.title: New alarm
user.description: Pick what should wake you. You'll set the time and days on the alarm's device page or the dashboard card.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. Bedroom alarm.
data_description.media_player: Media player to wake you, e.g. a Sonos speaker. Optional if you only use lights.
data_description.source: Name of a source or Sonos favorite to select. Used when no media content ID is set.
data_description.media_content_id: Exact content to play (URL, playlist ID, favorite item ID). Takes priority over Source.
data_description.media_content_type: Type for the content ID above.
data_description.volume_ramp_minutes: Minutes to go from starting to final volume. 0 = jump straight to final volume.
data_description.lights: Lights to fade in before the alarm.
data_description.light_fade_minutes: Lights start this many minutes before the alarm time and reach full brightness when it rings. 0 = lights turn on at alarm time.
data_description.kelvin_start: Warm start for lights that support color temperature.
data_description.auto_dismiss_minutes: Stop playback automatically if nobody dismisses. 0 = never.

error.nothing_to_do: Choose a speaker, lights, or both.
error.volume_order: Final volume must be at least the starting volume.

abort.already_configured: An alarm with this name already exists.

set_days.name: Set days
set_days.description: Set which weekdays an alarm repeats on. An empty list makes it a one-time alarm.

dismiss.name: Dismiss
dismiss.description: Stop a ringing or snoozed alarm, or skip a fade-in already under way.

trigger.description: Ring an alarm now, for testing.
